items.subject: Crowded 1961 Madrid ballroom of Spanish couples; at its centre a slim late-20s Spanish man in a dark suit and a mid-20s Spanish woman in a modest full-skirted dress, meeting at the edge of the dance floor
items.action: Couples circle the polished floor while the young pair stands face to face, just introduced
items.gaze_interaction: The pair turn toward each other, heads slightly inclined; other dancers seen mostly from behind
items.setting: Grand early-20th-century ballroom of the Círculo de Bellas Artes, Madrid, 1961, with marble columns, gilded mouldings and tall windows
items.color_palette: Warm gold, ivory, burgundy velvet, dark wool suits
items.props_detail: A crystal chandelier blazing above the dance floor
items.camera_angle: high angle from the gallery balcony
items.lighting: Warm evening chandelier light with soft amber glow
items.mood: Gentle evening warmth, swirling skirts, relaxed shoulders, soft lamplight
items.narration_anchor: Dieciséis de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y uno. En el salón de baile del Círculo de Bellas Artes de Madrid, Daniel Écija conoce a María Bernal.

items.subject: Newlywed Spanish couple, late-20s man in a dark suit and mid-20s woman in a simple 1960s white dress, with a small group of Spanish relatives
items.action: The couple steps down from a church doorway onto the street after their weekday wedding
items.gaze_interaction: Couple seen walking away from camera, arm in arm; relatives turned toward them
items.setting: Modest Madrid parish church facade and stone steps, 1962, narrow street with a parked period car
items.color_palette: Sun-bleached stone, faded ochre walls, black and white wedding clothes, pale September sky
items.props_detail: A small bouquet held at the bride's side
items.mood: Quiet daylight, an unhurried walk, a modest gathering on worn steps
items.narration_anchor: Un año después se casan: el jueves veinte de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y dos.

items.subject: Hundreds of Spanish emigrants, men and women in their 20s and 30s in sun-faded 1960s clothes, filling the frame along the rail of a large white emigrant ocean liner
items.action: Passengers crowd the decks as the ship prepares to leave the quay
items.gaze_interaction: Most figures read as silhouettes at the rail facing the shore
items.setting: Spanish Mediterranean harbour quay, 1962, cranes, cargo sheds, mooring ropes
items.color_palette: White hull, rust streaks, harbour grey, faded blues and browns of clothing
items.props_detail: Battered cardboard suitcases stacked on the quay
items.mood: Crowded rails, waiting bodies, calm harbour water under clear light
items.narration_anchor: Cuatro días más tarde ya están en el barco. Van a Australia con el acuerdo migratorio por el que pasaron cerca de ocho mil españoles.

items.subject: Young Spanish couple, late-20s man and mid-20s woman in simple travel clothes, seen from behind at a ship's rail
items.action: They stand side by side looking out over endless open sea
items.gaze_interaction: Both face the horizon, backs to camera, shoulders touching
items.setting: Open promenade deck of a 1960s ocean liner on the open sea
items.color_palette: Deep ocean blue, white painted steel, faded beige and grey clothing
items.props_detail: A single worn leather suitcase at their feet
items.lighting: Neutral open-sea daylight with soft haze
items.mood: Two small figures before a vast empty horizon, a light breeze in their clothes
items.narration_anchor: De Wittenoom no saben nada; saben que hay trabajo y que van juntos.

items.subject: Mid-20s Spanish migrant woman, slight build, dark hair pinned back, in a simple cotton dress, beside her late-20s Spanish husband
items.action: She walks the deck pressed close against her husband's arm, holding on to him
items.gaze_interaction: Her face turned toward the front, eyes lifted toward the horizon, head leaning near his shoulder
items.setting: Sunlit deck of a 1960s emigrant liner mid-voyage
items.color_palette: Sea blue, white steel, faded floral cotton, dark wool
items.props_detail: A small embroidered handbag hanging from her other arm
items.mood: Body tucked close against his side, chin lifted, steady stride in warm light
items.narration_anchor: «Iba pegadita a mi marido, como una niña», recuerda su mujer.

items.subject: Two young Spanish couples in their 20s and 30s, dusty work trousers and faded cotton dresses
items.action: They share a simple table on a veranda, talking at the end of the day
items.gaze_interaction: Heads turned toward one another, one woman laughing, the men leaning back
items.setting: Veranda of a corrugated-iron and asbestos-cement house in a 1962 Pilbara mining town, red earth beyond
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, weathered grey sheeting, dusty blue sky at dusk
items.props_detail: An enamel coffee pot on the table filmed with fine dust
items.mood: Long warm shadows, relaxed seated postures, dust hanging in low sun
items.narration_anchor: Con el tiempo se hicieron amigos íntimos de otra pareja, Milagros Barroso y Ramón de Juan. Esa familia madrileña había hecho el mismo viaje un mes antes.

items.subject: A young Spanish boy around eight, thin build, in shorts and a short-sleeved shirt, small on a broad liner deck
items.action: He stands in the blazing sun on the deck, shirt stuck to his back
items.gaze_interaction: Looking out over the shimmering sea, one arm raised to shade his eyes
items.setting: Open steel deck of a 1960s emigrant liner in tropical heat
items.color_palette: Bleached white deck, glaring sky, deep sea blue, faded cotton
items.props_detail: A canvas deck chair with a damp towel draped over it
items.camera_angle: high angle from the upper deck
items.mood: Heat shimmer, sweat-darkened shirt, hard short shadows
items.narration_anchor: Un niño que hizo ese viaje todavía recuerda el calor.

items.subject: A young Spanish boy around eight with his Spanish family, mother in her 30s and father in work clothes, among other emigrants
items.action: The family climbs the gangway into the towering ship
items.gaze_interaction: The boy glances back over his shoulder toward the quay, face to camera
items.setting: Málaga harbour quay, 1962, beneath the steep white hull of an emigrant liner
items.color_palette: White hull, rust, harbour stone, faded browns and blues
items.props_detail: A rope-tied cardboard suitcase carried by the father
items.mood: Small figures against a towering hull, the boy's backward glance, steady climb
items.narration_anchor: Víctor Calvo era un niño cuando subió a ese barco.

items.subject: An emigrant ocean liner leaving Málaga harbour
items.action: The ship pulls away, its wake widening as the city recedes
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction toward the open sea ahead of the bow
items.setting: Málaga port and Mediterranean coastline, 1962, cathedral and hills on the shore
items.color_palette: Mediterranean blue, white hull, sand-coloured city, pale sky
items.props_detail: A long white wake trailing behind the stern
items.camera_angle: high angle from the harbour hill
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: A long wake, a shrinking shoreline, calm open water ahead
items.narration_anchor: «Salimos de Málaga y tardamos más de 20 días en llegar en barco a Australia», dice Calvo.

items.subject: An emigrant liner gliding through the narrow Suez Canal, passengers as tiny silhouettes at the rails
items.action: The ship slides slowly between desert banks under scorching sun
items.gaze_interaction: Focal line along the canal toward the hazy horizon
items.setting: Suez Canal, 1962, flat sand banks, a few palms and a mud-brick signal station
items.color_palette: Bleached sand, pale khaki, white hull, washed-out blue sky
items.props_detail: Heat haze rippling above the sand banks
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, telephoto compression
items.mood: Shimmering heat, motionless water, white glare
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda el canal de Suez y el calor que hacía ahí, un calor que todavía lo hace resoplar cuando lo cuenta.

items.subject: A seasick young Spanish boy around eight lying on a narrow bunk, his Spanish mother in her 30s sitting beside him
items.action: The boy lies curled on his side while the cabin rolls; the mother leans against the bunk frame
items.gaze_interaction: Mother turned toward the small porthole, boy's eyes half-closed
items.setting: Cramped steel third-class cabin of a 1960s liner, bunks, riveted walls
items.color_palette: Painted cream steel, dull grey blankets, sea-green porthole light
items.props_detail: A metal basin on the floor beside the bunk
items.lighting: Single shaft of greenish light from the porthole
items.mood: Sweat-damp hair, slumped shoulders, tilted horizon through the porthole
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda los mareos. Y la incertidumbre: no saber muy bien adónde iban ni cómo iban a vivir.

items.subject: A small 1960s twin-propeller passenger plane
items.action: The plane bucks and tilts in hot thermals over the desert
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction along the wing toward the red ranges below
items.setting: Sky above the red Pilbara ranges and gorges, Western Australia, 1962
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre ridges, silver fuselage, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: Spinning propellers blurred against the heat haze
items.camera_angle: low angle from below the wing line
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, slight motion blur on propellers
items.mood: Tilted wings, rippling heat, vast red emptiness below
items.narration_anchor: Después del barco, un avión pequeño, de hélices, que se sacude durante todo el vuelo.

items.subject: A small propeller plane on a bush airstrip, Spanish migrant families in faded 1960s clothes stepping down onto the strip
items.action: The plane rolls to a stop, raising a thick cloud of dust over the passengers
items.gaze_interaction: Passengers seen from behind, heads lowered against the dust
items.setting: Remote airstrip of grey-blue compacted waste in a vast red Pilbara desert, 1962
items.color_palette: Deep red earth, ochre, grey-blue strip surface, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A weathered painted wooden sign beside the strip
items.mood: Billowing dust, squinting bodies, an empty red horizon

text_in_image.location: on the wooden sign beside the strip

items.narration_anchor: Aterriza en una pista en medio de una tierra muy roja, en el desierto de Pilbara, en Australia Occidental. Hay polvo por todas partes.

items.subject: Active 1962 mining town of small corrugated-iron, timber and asbestos-cement houses; a Spanish family with suitcases, a boy around eight among them
items.action: The newly arrived family is led down a dusty street toward the houses
items.gaze_interaction: The boy turns his head toward the dust drifting over the rooftops
items.setting: Wittenoom town in the red Pilbara gorge country, 1962, new low houses, grey-blue surfaced street
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, fresh grey sheeting, galvanised iron, hints of blue in the ground
items.props_detail: Fine dust coating a corrugated-iron fence
items.mood: Dust in the air, long empty street, small figures under a glaring sky
items.narration_anchor: Ese niño cuenta que nunca había visto tanto polvo. Los llevan a las casas: chapa, madera y uralita.

items.subject: Crocidolite mine in a red gorge, dust-covered miners of Australian and Spanish origin in their 20s-40s, small against the rock
items.action: Ore is hauled from the mine adit as trucks wait below
items.gaze_interaction: Miners seen from behind and in profile, bent to the work
items.setting: Steep red-walled Pilbara gorge, 1962, mine entrance, timber chutes, a dusty mill beyond
items.color_palette: Red rock, ochre, steel-blue seams of mineral, grey dust
items.props_detail: A seam of blue fibrous mineral glinting in the gorge wall
items.mood: Dust-coated workers dwarfed by red cliffs, haze hanging over the gorge
items.narration_anchor: De esa tierra sacan crocidolita, el asbesto azul, un mineral que se paga bien porque aguanta el calor y no se gasta.

items.subject: Spanish migrant woman in her 30s in a faded cotton dress, a young boy around eight playing nearby in a house patio
items.action: She pegs out laundry as the patio surface lifts into drifting dust around the playing boy
items.gaze_interaction: Woman facing the front, eyes on the boy; the boy kneels absorbed in the ground
items.setting: Backyard patio of a corrugated-iron and asbestos-cement house, Wittenoom, 1962
items.color_palette: Red earth, grey-blue ground, faded laundry whites, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: White sheets on the line greyed by settling dust
items.mood: Dust drifting through sunlight, ordinary chores, a child's bare knees in the grey ground
items.narration_anchor: Nadie les dijo qué era el polvo. La compañía lo sabía desde hacía dieciocho años.
